title: Deeper/broader ACadSharp Python bridge and UnCAD route-lineage refresh
mode: primary-source repository, package-provenance, issue, and local-plan research
scope: Screen a newly published Python-facing ACadSharp artifact and identify its parser lineage
Refresh UnCAD's current DWG, DXF, writer, renderer, and test-input routes
Reconcile recent ACadSharp spline and LibreDWG block-writer reports with existing libdxfrw owners
Refine optional peer selection without adding implementation-slice validation cost

method.kind: Read public primary project pages, PyPI provenance, issue reports, and current local plan/test ownership
method.limitations: Peer documentation and public issues are route/source claims, not executed conformance results. ACadSharp.Python's recursive ACadSharp submodule revision was not resolved from an installed artifact or checkout. The issue #1299 attachment and external diagnostic were not downloaded or independently inspected. No local peer or native-CAD run was performed.

sources.revision: PyPI 0.1.0 page reviewed 2026-10-18; publisher provenance identifies wrapper commit 25a8243cff364008392dba9cca6b80b88f08e50a
sources.observed: The project describes Python.NET bindings to ACadSharp's actual public .NET object model and says ACadSharp is pinned as a recursive Git submodule. The package cautions that complete API exposure does not imply support for all DWG/DXF features. This is a harness interface to the ACadSharp lineage, not an independent parser.

sources.revision: Mutable main README and workspace/test-layout description reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The project documents DWG read through vendored, locally patched LibreDWG FFI; DXF read through the separate pure-Rust undxf crate; SVG/PNG through a renderer; and removal of its earlier DWG/DXF write API. Its real-file integration tests require the LibreDWG submodule. It adds no independent DWG parser or current writer route; undxf remains a distinct read-side DXF candidate.
The organization lists explicit forks of ACadSharp and dxf-rs and the Kaitai DWG schema project. These repository names do not establish additional independently implemented runtime parsers.

sources.revision: Open issue page reviewed 2026-10-18; report cites ACadSharp 3.8.0
sources.observed: The reporter says a converted DXF contains bad SPLINE data that makes GDAL conversion fail and attaches a DWG/DXF archive. The issue body does not provide expected control points, knots, weights, source handle, independently derived curve, or inspectable diagnosis; the attachment was not retrieved. This remains a peer report, not normative SPLINE behavior or a local failure.

sources.revision: Open issue page and activity reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The report describes a mutable object-array loop-index bug that omits later BLOCK and paper-space bodies in the ASCII and Binary DXF writers, with a BLOCK_RECORD-to-BLOCK count invariant and per-owner examples. The plan's existing generated ASCII/Binary owner census and consecutive-block tests already cover the relevant local structural route; no equivalent local defect was reproduced.

assessment.planImpact: Adds ACadSharp.Python as an optional adapter to an existing peer lineage; clarifies that current UnCAD DWG reading is LibreDWG-correlated and that its write API has been removed; retains #1299 and #1409 under existing SPLINE and block-owner gates. Optional peer use remains composed-checkpoint-only.

implementationReadyChecks: Keep per-slice validation to the strict touched-target build, focused locally generated selector, applicable compatibility check, and owning CTest; do not install or run peer wrappers per slice.

At a composed checkpoint, bind the exact parser, wrapper, recursive submodule, runtime, features, operation, source/target version, command, input/output hashes, diagnostics, and source-to-output owner disposition.
Treat ACadSharp.Python as the ACadSharp parser lineage; the wrapper commit and package attestation do not by themselves identify or qualify the recursive ACadSharp revision.
Treat UnCAD DWG read as LibreDWG lineage, undxf as a separate DXF read route, rendering as projection, and its removed write API as unavailable.
Reuse PAR-22/7H independent SPLINE expectations and PAR-49/7G per-owner block closure; do not turn issue attachments or GDAL failure into normative expected results.
Use only already-authorized or locally authored-from-scratch controls; do not commit peer/customer drawings.
Do not let wrapper exposure, issue reports, parser counts, or route discovery promote J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, or J295.

workingTree.reason: The shared checkout has extensive pre-existing tracked and untracked work. This research pass changed only the parity plan and its new receipt; unrelated changes were preserved.
